outcome: difficulty of laparoscopic cholecystectomy (easy, difficult, very difficult)
injury to cystic duct or cystic artery
cohort: Patients who underwent elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy between January 2018 and January 2022 at a tertiary center, excluding those with acute cholecystitis, CBD stone, or dilated CBD (>6mm).
finding: Sex, BMI, previous history of hospitalization, palpable GB, and thickened GB wall were statistically significant predictors of difficult laparoscopic cholecystectomy, with previous history of hospitalization and GB wall thickness being highly significant.
